svg.title: Caryatid: elevation · close-up in context
svg.desc: Elevation of a draped female figure standing in place of a column, weight on one leg, carrying an entablature on a basket capital, with light shading on the side away from the light, and a shaded round close-up of her head, braids and capital. Source: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.

g.text: CLOSE-UP · ×4 · FIGURE 2.3 m TALL · LIGHT FROM THE UPPER LEFT
DRAPED FEMALE FIGURE SERVING AS A COLUMN
SOURCE: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric
construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.
